newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Siddons says Q1 profit slightly ahead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Siddons says Q1 profit slightly ahead.

text.p: Light engineering and hardware group Siddons Ramset Ltd said on Monday its profit for the first quarter for the financial year was slightly ahead of the same period a year ago despite a competitive trading environment.
"The trading for the first three months of the current financial year has been very competitive," Siddons Ramset chairman John Siddons told the annual meeting.
"Our results, however, are marginally ahead of the previous corresponding period," he said.
Siddons said expectations for the building industry in Australia and New Zealand in the current half were "not encouraging."
"We anticipate that there may be some improvement in calendar 1997," he said.
Siddons reported an 11.8 percent rise in net profit for the year to June 30 to A$19.35 million on sales of A$269.19 million, up 11.4 percent from a year earlier.
